metadata.repository_display_label: Intimidator 305 Pov With G force readings

repository_review.claim: The overlay is a single signed rider-frame normal (vertical) g trace; no lateral or longitudinal trace is present.
Overlay clock equals video time plus 0.21 s; the documented element windows use overlay/ride seconds.
Read values are approximately ±0.15 g and times approximately ±0.15 s.

independent_timeline.continuity: The repository records an overlay-to-video offset, but no cross-source or generated alignment is asserted.

evidence_gaps: The oEmbed endpoint was unavailable during offline artifact preparation; title and channel are repository-supplied metadata rather than independently re-fetched oEmbed fields.
No committed local video artifact or SHA-256 is available.
The documented windows are vertical/normal-g only; lateral and longitudinal axes must not be inferred.
Value and time readings carry approximately ±0.15 g and ±0.15 s uncertainty, respectively.
The imagery and g data come from different sources, so element-to-time attribution follows the uploader's synchronization and is not certified.
This corroborative source cannot define executable comparison bands alone.
